raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Commit DE-398 (2026-01-16) changed silver_transactions.txn_date to CAST(ingest_ts AS DATE). Every ingest_ts is the next day at 02:00, so txn_date is always one day after the transaction's own date, which explains the 4558 mismatches (all POSTED rows). Deriving txn_date from txn_ts restores the DATE_CONSISTENCY invariant, and the gold tables rebuild from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
